song.name: Blood Ritual
song.plot: Acheron executes the primordial transformation ritual using Nyktoros's blueprints. Fusing his Aurorian light with void frequencies, he transforms himself and his inner circle into the first vampires, awakening the Thirst.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "ancient blood ritual" piece. The reworked version anchors it to the canonical transformation: fusing Aurorian spark with void frequencies (Nyktoros's blueprints) to create the first vampires and awaken the Thirst. The chorus's "Aurorian spark and void set free" and "A primal Thirst, awakened deep" are direct lore references. Preserves the 6-line chorus and 4-line verse structure. Suggested song direction: ritualistic, intense, transcendent — pulsing tribal drums, eerie chanting, building orchestral swells.
